tail -n 9 .local/podcast-editorial-upgrade/production-build-final.log; git diff --stat -- classic/apps/web/src/ai crates/editor-api/src/operations/classic_takes/podcast* crates/editor-api/tests/classic_podcast*; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
for mode in ('highlights','chronological'):
 p=Path(f'.local/podcast-editorial-upgrade/{mode}-real.json')
 if p.exists():
  d=json.loads(p.read_text());print(json.dumps({'mode':mode,'words':d['wordCount'],'rounds':d['report']['rounds'],'titles':[x['title'] for x in d['videos']],'sourceScenesExact':d['sourceScenesExact']},ensure_ascii=False))
PY
